_meta.purpose: Seed taxonomy for the candidate topic universe. Three levels: legal domain -> practice areas -> seed episode topics. The Checks phase resolves the client's legal domain, scrapes the firm website to confirm which practice areas the firm actually covers, and loads each confirmed area's seed_topics as the STARTING POINT of the candidate set. The research pass (2A entity + 2B keyword + 2C virality) then adds whatever it surfaces - location-specific topics, newly-trending topics - and score-topics.py scores the whole set. The seed is ONLY a starting point, never a guaranteed shortlist: every seed topic is scored exactly like a research-derived topic, gets NO scoring or selection advantage, and a seed topic the data does not support scores low and lands RESERVE or CUT just like any other weak candidate. The seed guarantees a topic is CONSIDERED every run; the score and the selection decide everything after that.
_meta.how_it_is_used: Checks -> 'Resolve client, domain, and practice areas' loads this file. For each confirmed practice area, seed_topics seed the candidate list before research-derived topics are merged in. score-topics.py scores the merged set.
_meta.how_it_grows: Two ways. (1) DEPTH - topics surfaced during research or the n-gram step (rows tagged 'surfaced from n-gram table' in the Topic Ideas Notes column) that prove out and are evergreen get folded back into the relevant practice area's seed_topics, so existing branches compound with every client run. Only generic, evergreen topics promote - genericize first (strip client / city / jurisdiction specifics); location-specific or passing-trend topics stay in that client's run and never enter the seed. (2) BREADTH - when CE breaks into a practice area or legal domain not yet in the catalog, add the new practice area (or whole domain) branch and seed it from that first client's research, the way Family Law was seeded from the Law Offices of Todd K. Mohink plan. A stub branch (status 'stub', empty seed_topics) is populated this way on its first real client. The catalog never ossifies and is never frozen - it deepens with every run and widens with every new practice area.
